description: Get the feature matrix for your competitive set: every canonical feature in your workspace's catalog, grouped by category, with which competitors market it and whether you do. Coverage comes from each product's public site, so a feature you're missing means you don't MARKET it — you may still have it unannounced. Use differences_only to hide rows where everyone (or no one) has it.

category.description: Filter to one category: core_workflow, collaboration, integrations, automation, analytics_reporting, ai_capabilities, security_compliance, administration, developer_api, mobile_platform, other

differences_only.description: Only return features where coverage differs across the set (default false)

name: outmano_get_feature_matrix

aligned_rival_count.description: Rivals whose features are mapped onto the catalog

gap.description: True when rivals market it and you do not

marketed_by.description: Rival names that market this feature

you_market_it.description: Absent when you have no own product tracked

feature_count.description: Features in the catalog before filtering
